text: Scalding Elementals were water elementals located in Thousand Needles.

Sazzmi Gentlehorn is a satyr that can be encountered as a boss in the single-player experience in the The Witchwood expansion for Hearthstone. She is able to use the music from her flute to lure various creatures into following her.
Sawtooth is a sawtooth shark located in Boralus Harbor in Boralus.
Scaleback Sea Turtles are sea turtles located in the Great Sea around Kul Tiras.
]] Sawtooth sharks are a type of shark with an elongated saw-like rostrum.
__NOTOC__ The Scaleclaw Broodmother is a saurolisk vignette located at the eastern end of the Arid Basin in Vol'dun.
__NOTOC__ Savage Hill Brutes are gnolls located in Snowblind Hills in the Storm Peaks.
__NOTOC__ Savage Hill Mystics are gnolls located in Snowblind Hills in the Storm Peaks.
__NOTOC__ Savage Hill Scavengers are gnolls located in Snowblind Hills in the Storm Peaks.
Sawtooth Jawbones drop from beasts in Kul Tiras and Zandalar.
Saylanna's Rod is a rod that was to be provided by Saylanna Riverbreeze. The rod would be used to disrupt the ritual of Blargrrrl.
Saved Murlocs are murlocs that would appear in the Arathi Highlands.
Savia "Anguish" Anguossa is a void elf located in Arathi Basin during Brawl: Comp Stomp for Horde players.
__NOTOC__ Savage Snapdragons are snapdragons located at Zanj'ir Terrace in Nazjatar. Feeding them with Chitterspine Roe will turn them into Sated Snapdragons for a few moments.
Savagemane Hatchlings are raptors located at the Feeding Grounds in Zuldazar.
Savage Sharpclaws are night elves who can be encountered in Verdant Wilds.
__NOTOC__ Scaleclaw Saurolisks are saurolisks located in the Arid Basin in Vol'dun.
Savannah Proudfangs are lions located in Uldum during the Assault in Uldum. Some are stealthed and others are napping.

Scale Lord Theronar is a hydra located in the Brinestone Cove in Nazjatar. He is overseen by two Kelfin Wranglers. He is very very hungry and must be fed by filling the Feeding Shell with Chitterspine Meat. Once his hunger is sated, he will allow adventurers to mount him, in order to defeat the Cracklemaw Colossus.
__NOTOC__ Scalding Springsurges are water elementals located at Frostfire Hot Springs in Winterspring.
__NOTOC__ Scale Matriarch Gratinax is a hydra located in Nazjatar.
__NOTOC__ Scale Matriarch Vynara is a hydra located in Nazjatar.
__NOTOC__ Scale Matriarch Zodia is a hydra located in the Ashen Strand in Nazjatar.
The Scale Helm of the Frigid Depths drops from Tide Behemoth in Azsuna.
Savannah Boars are boars located in the Southern Barrens. Razormane Pathfinders can be seen taming them into Razormane Boars.
Savol'skis is a Zandalari troll whose skull can be found at the Head Shop in Dazar'alor.
Savagewing Teroclaws are cloudfeathers located in western Ardenweald.
Savior is an Azerite trait available to classes that have a healer specialization.
Scalding Brew is a conduit for Brewmaster monks. It drops from Surgeon Stitchflesh in the Necrotic Wake and Halondrus in the Sepulcher of the First Ones. It is also sold by Zo'sorg in Oribos for .
Sc'ootie's Favorite Plushies are sold by the Toy Vendor in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market.
The Saw Blade would have been a quest reward from You're the Bomb!
Scale-Cord of the Raptor is a quest reward from Raptor Mastery.
Savage Handguards are a quest reward from Stranglethorn Fever.

The Scale Vest of the Shaman was added as a reward to the removed quest Taragaman the Hungerer (quest). As such, the appearance will be learned by players having completed that quest in the past despite the item never being obtainable.
Savage Gladiator's Mutilator was never available to players.

Saw Dust was obtained from Warfang Lumberjacks, Warfang Peons and Dead Lumberjack at the Clearcut in Stormsong Valley.
Scale Piercing Fangs drop from dragon whelps and proto-dragons on the Dragon Isles.
Scalding is a black whelp located next to Igys the Believer at the Slagmire in the Waking Shores.
Scaldrons of Molten Might drops from Eranog in the Vault of the Incarnates.
Savage Wasps are silithid wasps found in the War of the Shifting Sands. They are found fighting Kaldorei Defenders.

The Scaleborn Pass connects the Caldera of the Menders to the west and the Lost Atheneum to the east in central Forbidden Reach. The Aerie Chasm lies to the southwest and the Old Weyrn Grounds is across the bridge to the south. The pass is inhabited by neutral vorquin and vorquin foals.

Savage Green Battle Turtle is an armored, cannon-touting turtle mount and the May 2023 completion award for filling out the Traveler's Log at the Trading Post. Similar to the Riding Turtle and Sea Turtle (mount) mounts, it is an aquatic mount that provides no movement speed increase on land but increases swim speed by 60%. Based on its cannons and its Horde-themed armor, the mount is likely inspired by the Giant Turtle units from Warcraft II.
]] Saza's Blade is looted from the corpse of Icebreaker while on Break Him as part of the Winterpelt Furbolg storyline at Skill 50. The blade starts the optional sidequest Returning the Blade.
Scale Rein Grips are created by Dragon Isles Leatherworking (100); taught by Pattern: Scale Rein Grips.
Savathal is a dracthyr located in Algeth'ar Academy in Thaldraszus.
Savory Deviant Dealfish drops from Hungering Azuretooth in the Azure Span.
Scalecommander's Ebon Schynbalds drops from Scalecommander Sarkareth in Aberrus, the Shadowed Crucible.
Savage Lobstrok is a lobstrok companion. It does not appear to be available.
Scalding Whelps are black whelps found near the Lethlor Ravine in the Badlands.
Scalding Broodlings are black whelps located in the Burning Steppes.

Instance= |-| Lore= The Scarlet Monastery, once known as The Old Monastery, is a fortified monastery located in the northeast corner of the blighted Tirisfal Glades, it was once a cathedral of the Church of the Holy Light, which was taken over by the Scarlet Crusade after the end of the Third War. Following the Cataclysm, the Scarlet Monastery was one of the last strongholds in the world that belonged to the fanatical Scarlet Crusade, as the Scarlet Bastion within the ruins of Stratholme, the town of Hearthglen, the town of Tyr's Han

The Scarlet Crusade (also known as the Scarlet Brotherhood or simply the Crusade) is a fanatical religious sect that evolved from the Knights of the Silver Hand, dedicated to the eradication of the undead from Lordaeron. A major adversary of the Forsaken and Scourge, their name has become synonymous with corruption and extremism, and several quests in Tirisfal Glades involve attacks on Scarlet Crusade troops, leaders, and strongholds. The Scarlet Crusade maintains several bastions throughout the former lands of Lordaeron, namely the Scarlet Monastery, and up until the Cataclysm - Hearthglen, Tyr's Hand, the fortified Scarlet Bastion of Stratholme, and several smaller camps and scout towers s
__NOTOC__ Scarlet Cavaliers are elite mobs located inside Mardenholde Keep of Hearthglen, which is in the Western Plaguelands.
Scaled Silithid Gauntlets are primarily sought after by hunters and enhancement shamans.
Scaled Bracers of the Gorger are a pair of leather bracers best suited to druids.
Scaled Leggings of Qiraji Fury are mail leggings for Shamans.
The Scarlet Belt dropped from Scarlet Defenders and Scarlet Myrmidons in the Scarlet Monastery prior to Mists of Pandaria. Part of Chain of the Scarlet Crusade set.
Scarlet Boots are mail feet armor with Agility and Stamina. It is part of the armor set Chain of the Scarlet Crusade.
Scarlet Gauntlets are a mail hand armor. They are part of the Chain of the Scarlet Crusade set.
Scarlet Medics are level 52-54 humans that have been killed in the Western Plaguelands.

Scarlet Raven Tavern (or the Scarlet Raven) is located in the town of Darkshire in Duskwood. Although the hearth has been kept warm, it now holds a more morose crowd while the darkness presses in on the tavern outside, which is downright bad for business. The inn features several quest givers, as well as a few vendors, and a Hero's Call Board at the entrance.
Scargil is a rare mob murloc found on the Western Strand in Hillsbrad Foothills. It is on a 5-8 hour respawn timer.
The Scarlet Executioner is a rare human found in the Western Plaguelands. The executioner is now one of the rare surviving Scarlet Crusade members in the area.

__NOTOC__ The Scarlet High Clerist is a rare human found in near Felstone Field in the Western Plaguelands. Since the Cataclysm, the high clerist is now one of the rare surviving Scarlet Crusade members in the area. He can be seen observing the corpses of his fellow crusaders.
The Scarlet Interrogator is a rare human found in Dalson's Farm the Western Plaguelands. The interrogator is now one of the rare surviving Scarlet Crusade members in the area.

The Scarlet Judge is a rare human found in the Western Plaguelands. He can be found near some crates and raw unidentified meat. The judge is now one of the rare surviving Scarlet Crusade members in the area.
Scarlet Commander Marjhan is an undead found at Tyr's Hand in the Eastern Plaguelands. She was formerly located at Light's Hope Chapel.
The Scarlet Base Camp is a small barricaded fortification located on the east banks of Lake Mereldar, not far from the religious bastion of Tyr's Hand.
The Scarab Dais is where the Scarab Gong is located, just northwest of the Scarab Wall outside of Ahn'Qiraj, in southern Silithus.
Scarlet Hounds are hyenas found in the Western Plaguelands. They are controlled by Scarlet Hunters.

The Scarab Lord is an achievement rewarded for opening the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj by completing the quest Bang a Gong!. The Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj and Temple of Ahn'Qiraj instances can only be made accessible by finishing the player-driven questline at the end of which the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj are opened. This title is no longer obtainable because all new realms were brought online with the Gates unlocked, and the Cataclysm expansion saw the removal of all quests relating to the world event.
Scaled Greaves of the Marksman are epic mail leg armor that drops from Doom Lord Kazzak at the Throne of Kil'jaeden in Hellfire Peninsula.
__NOTOC__ :"I've slain dragons and demons! What are you compared to them?!" —Shaii Scaled Breastplate of Carnage is an epic mail DPS chestpiece that drops from Nightbane in Karazhan.
Scarecrow Trousers drop from Foe Reaper 4000 in Westfall. During , it was available again via Crate of Salvage and Big Crate of Salvage.
Scarab Trousers are a quest reward from Escape Through Stealth.
Scarlet Crusade Documents are important reports and orders formerly carried by Meven Korgal for distribution throughout the Scarlet Crusader commanders throughout Tirisfal Glades.
Scaled Draenic Vest is created with Leatherworking (325); taught by trainers.
Scaled Draenic Gloves are leather gloves crafted by leathercrafters.
Scaled Draenic Pants are created with Leatherworking (300); taught by trainers.
Scaled Legs of Ruination is a quest reward from: *The Breaker *Mind the Gap *The Blood is Life

Scarlet Insignia Rings drop from the following Scarlet Crusade soldiers in Tirisfal Glades: *Captain Melrache *Captain Perrine *Captain Vachon *Scarlet Bodyguard *Scarlet Friar *Scarlet Missionary *Scarlet Neophyte *Scarlet Vanguard *Scarlet Warrior *Scarlet Zealot

__NOTOC__ Scarlet Initiates are human caster mobs located in a camp southeast of Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades. They were newly recruited members of the Scarlet Crusade who have been sent to harass the undead-infested village. They were the first caster mob that new Forsaken players met. Executor Arren sent new players out to battle them and collect their armbands.
Scarlet Armbands drop from the following members of the Scarlet Crusade in Tirisfal Glades: *Scarlet Initiate *Meven Korgal *Scarlet Convert
).]] The Scarlet Initiate Robes drop from Scarlet Initiates in Tirisfal Glades.

__NOTOC__ Scarlet Converts are the freshly recruited, dagger-wielding fanatics of the Scarlet Crusade, located in a camp southwest of Deathknell in the Tirisfal Glades. Executor Arren sends new players to battle them and collect their armbands.
Scaled Draenic Armor is a mail uncommon crafted set from the Burning Crusade. It is crafted by Leatherworking.
Scarab Coffer Keys are used to open Scarab Coffers in the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj.
Scarlet Beastmasters were humans of the Scarlet Crusade that could once be found inside the Library wing of the Scarlet Monastery.

Scarlet Friars are humans found near Scarlet Watch Post in Tirisfal Glades. As soldiers of the Scarlet Crusade, these troops do constant battle with the forces of the Forsaken and the effects of the Scourge invasion. Some are found slain at the Scarlet Encampment and the Crusader Outpost.
Scarlet Centurions are humans of the Scarlet Crusade that can be found inside the Forlorn Cloister of the Scarlet Monastery.
Scarlet Monks were level 33-39 elite human monks of the Scarlet Crusade that could once be found inside the Library and Cathedral wings of the Scarlet Monastery.
Scarlet Hunters are humans found in the Western Plaguelands. They were in constant combat with the Scourge. After the Cataclysm, all were killed and caught in purple fire.
Scarlet Knights could be found in the northern area of the Western Plaguelands.
The Scaled Marshwalkers is a quest reward from Cleansing Witch Hill.
Scarlet Defenders are humans of the Scarlet Crusade that can be found inside the Scarlet Halls.
Scarlet Myrmidons are humans of the Scarlet Crusade that can be found inside the Scarlet Halls.
Scarlet Abbots were level 39 elite humans of the Scarlet Crusade that could once be found inside the Cathedral wing of the Scarlet Monastery.
Retail= |-| Classic= __NOTOC__ Scarlet Clerics are undead clerics — members of the Scarlet Crusade raised into undeath — found at Tyr's Hand in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Scarlet Footlockers are locked chests located in the buildings and around the grounds of Tyr's Hand in southeastern corner of the Eastern Plaguelands.

The Scarab Terrace is a subregion of Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj, and is the first area past the instance portal. The Scarab Terrace leads directly to the area where Kurinnaxx can be found, and beyond that, to the General's Terrace.
This is a page listing loot to be found in Scarlet Monastery. For information about the instance itself, see Scarlet Monastery.
Scarlet Protectors were level 35 - 36 elite humans of the Scarlet Crusade that could once be found inside the Armory wing of the Scarlet Monastery.

Scarlet Evokers are humans of the Scarlet Crusade that can be found inside the Footman's Armory of the Scarlet Halls. They were also encountered in the Scarlet Monastery when it was attacked by the Ebon Blade in order to raise Sally Whitemane during the Burning Legion's third invasion.

:Were you looking for the Scarlet Cannons on the ships at Light's Point in the Eastern Plaguelands? The Scarlet Cannon is located in Stratholme. This canon is used during the fight with Cannon Master Willey. It requires a to use, which can be found in the nearby Cannonball Stacks.
Scarab Coffers are located in throughout the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj. A Scarab Coffer Key is needed to open one.
Scarlet Chaplains were elite humans of the Scarlet Crusade that could once be found inside the Library and Cathedral wings of the Scarlet Monastery.
Retail= |-| Classic= __NOTOC__ Scarlet Enchanters are undead of the Scarlet Crusade located in Tyr's Hand in Eastern Plaguelands. Before the Cataclysm they were humans.
Scarlet Conjurors were humans of the Scarlet Crusade that could once be found inside the Armory wing of the Scarlet Monastery.
__NOTOC__ Scarlet Ivy are orchids found in the Vibrant Glade in the Howling Fjord.

Scarlet Hold is located in east New Avalon. High Abbot Landgren and High General Abbendis are situated out front fending off a mob of displeased Citizens of Havenshire and New Avalon who are distraught over the Scourge's attacks on New Avalon and Havenshire. In the non-instanced version, the barracks can be seen in ruins. The hold is involved in the following quest: *Death Comes From On High
The Scarlet Overlook is located east of New Avalon, just to the southwest of the Scarlet Hold on the bluffs above King's Harbor.
Scarlet Farm Hounds are mastiffs found on the Havenshire Stables in the Scarlet Enclave.
__NOTOC__ Scarlet Crusaders are humans found in New Avalon in the Scarlet Enclave.
Scarlet Commanders are humans located in New Avalon in the Scarlet Enclave.
They are involved in the following quest: *Lambs To The Slaughter
Scarlet Crusade Prisoners are humans located in Acherus: The Ebon Hold in the Scarlet Enclave.
Scarlet Peasants are human peasants of the Scarlet Crusade located in Havenshire in the Scarlet Enclave during the Death knight starting experience.
Scarlet Infantrymen are humans located in Havenshire in the Scarlet Enclave.

Scarlet Captains were human captains of the Scarlet Crusade residing in Havenshire during the death knight starting experience. They are in charge of the crusaders in the area and overseeing the Scarlet Peasants finishing their job at the Havenshire Lumber Mill.

Scarlet Ghouls are ghouls created from Scarlet Miners in the Havenshire Mine as a successful result of using the Gift of the Harvester while on the quest The Gift That Keeps On Giving. In phase two, Scarlet Ghouls are created by Acherus Necromancers on the beach at Light's Point from the corpses of fallen Scarlet Fleet Defenders.
Scarlet Miners are objectives of the quest The Gift That Keeps On Giving. Death knights are to use the Gift of the Harvester on them to hopefully turn them into Scarlet Ghouls and not Scarlet Ghosts.
Scarlet Ghosts are wraiths created from Scarlet Miners while on the quest The Gift That Keeps On Giving. Wraiths are not the desired result, as Gothik the Harvester wants Scarlet Ghouls instead.

Scarlet Fleet Defenders is a Scarlet Crusade guard armed with a gun, some of them are mounted on a horse, patrolling the forces that stands ready to defend themselves. They can be found in the Scarlet Enclave.
The Scarlet Land Cannons are being used by the Scarlet Fleet Defenders to defend the fleet from Death's Breach attackers.

The Scarlet Courier is a somewhat simple-minded emissary of the Scarlet Crusade. He was sent with a message from High Commander Galvar Pureblood, leading an army of the Scarlet Crusade to fight off the death knights of Acherus, but was distracted by a fake tree set up by the death knights to cover an ambush. This plays out in Ambush At The Overlook.
Scarlet Ballistae are ballistae located in New Avalon in Plaguelands: The Scarlet Enclave.

__NOTOC__ Scarlet Highlord Daion is a rare elite human of the Scarlet Onslaught found in Dragonblight. She can spawn in any of the three Onslaught territories in the zone: New Hearthglen, the Onslaught Base Camp, or Scarlet Point. She is initially mounted on a horse, but dismounts when aggroed.
The Scaled Armor of Drakos drops from Drakos the Interrogator in the Oculus on heroic mode.

The Scarlet Onslaught Prisoner is a human held captive inside a cage by the Forsaken apothecaries at Venomspite in the Dragonblight. He is involved in the quest Blighted Last Rites. His apparent immunity to the New Plague forces Apothecary Vicky Levine to find an alternative way to prevent the Scarlet Onslaught corpses from being raised by their priests or by the Scourge.
Scaled Icewalkers are crafted with Northrend Leatherworking (40); Taught by trainers.
Scalper Ahunae is a Zandalari troll quest giver located at Zim'Torga in Zul'Drak.
Scarlet Onslaught Armor Stands can be found throughout New Hearthglen in Dragonblight.
Scarlet Onslaught Weapon Racks can be found throughout New Hearthglen in Dragonblight.
The Scarlet Onslaught Daily Orders: Beach can be found in New Hearthglen in Dragonblight.

The Scarlet Onslaught Daily Orders: Barracks can be found in New Hearthglen in Dragonblight. on the first floor in the center of the building on a table near the stairs leading up to the second floor.
__NOTOC__ The two Scarlet Bodyguards are Captain Melrache's henchmen. They are found guarding him at the Scarlet Watch Post in the Tirisfal Glades.
Scarlet Diviners were level 33 elite humans of the Scarlet Crusade that could once be found inside the Library wing of the Scarlet Monastery.
Scarlet Gallants were level 32-33 elite humans of the Scarlet Crusade that could once be found inside the Library wing of the Scarlet Monastery.
Scarlet Adepts were level 32-33 elite humans of the Scarlet Crusade that could once be found inside the Library wing of the Scarlet Monastery.

Scarlet Onslaught Daily Orders are made out of the Scarlet Onslaught Daily Orders: Abbey, Scarlet Onslaught Daily Orders: Barracks, Scarlet Onslaught Daily Orders: Beach and sent by Spy Mistress Repine to her undercover Agent Skully in The Spy in New Hearthglen.
This item is a reward for completing Off With Their Black Wings.
Scarlet Crusade Disguise is a passive buff rewarded from the quest A Meeting With Fate.
Scarlet Onslaught Armor is looted from Scarlet Onslaught Armor Stands throughout New Hearthglen in the Dragonblight.

Scarlet Filigreed Shirt is a shirt item that can be purchased for from the following vendors: * in Dalaran over Northrend * in Dalaran over the Broken Isles It can also be obtained from Free T-Shirts in Orgrimmar or Stormwind during Free T-Shirt Day.

Scarlet Filigreed Doublet is a shirt item that can be purchased for from the following vendors: * in Dalaran over Northrend * in Dalaran over the Broken Isles It can also be obtained from Free T-Shirts in Orgrimmar or Stormwind during Free T-Shirt Day.
Scaleslicer is a random drop from trash mobs in Blackwing Descent.

The Scarlet Palisade is a Scarlet Crusade fortified camp located just west of the Solliden Farmstead in Tirisfal Glades. It is from here the Scarlet Warriors protect the neighboring farm from any non-human that comes near. In the center of the camp is the Crusader's Outpost.
The following NPCs can be found in Plaguelands: The Scarlet Enclave.
Scarab Hatchlings are critters found in Ahn'Qiraj: The Fallen Kingdom and in Silithus near the gates to Ahn'Qiraj.
Scarlet Neophytes are humans located at the Scarlet Watch Post in Tirisfal Glades.
The Scalpel of Unrelenting Agony drops from Yor'sahj the Unsleeping in Dragon Soul.

The Cathedral is part of the Scarlet Monastery complex. The Cathedral is definitely the toughest of the four wings, with multiple rough pulls, and will require 5 people. The two bosses, Scarlet Commander Mograine and High Inquisitor Whitemane, are fought at the same time. The Cathedral is tuned for players between level 36 and 41.
The Scarlet Monastery Armory is part of the Scarlet Monastery complex. The Armory requires 5 people, although 4 can probably down Herod, and is intended for players between level 35 and 37.
The Library is part of the is part of the Scarlet Monastery complex. The Library is for players between level 32 and 36, and requires five people to complete at this level range.

The Scarlet Monastery Graveyard is a part of the Scarlet Monastery complex. The Graveyard is intended for players between level 28 and 33, and can be done even without a full group, usually with 3-4 people.
Scarlet Fanatics are level 32 - 91 elite human monks of the Scarlet Crusade that can be found in the Chapel Gardens of the Scarlet Monastery.

Scarlet Judicators are humans of the Scarlet Crusade found in the Chapel Gardens of the Scarlet Monastery. The first judicators seen are drunk as can be and are neutral instead of hostile. Feel free to ignore them.
Scarlet Purifiers are level 32 - 91 elite humans of the Scarlet Crusade that can be found in the Chapel Gardens of the Scarlet Monastery.
Scarlet Monastery Guild Run is a guild achievement that is awarded for defeating the boss of the Scarlet Monastery instance while in a guild group.

Scarlet Guardians guard the exit of the Huntsman's Cloister in the Scarlet Halls while Houndmaster Braun is still alive. At the end of the Braun encounter, the guardians will all be killed by the escaping mastiffs.
Scarlet Evangelists are level 29-91 elite humans of the Scarlet Crusade that can be found in the Footman's Armory of the Scarlet Halls.
Scarlet Cannoneers are humans located in the Footman's Armory in Scarlet Halls.
Scarlet Hall Guardians are elite humans of the Scarlet Crusade that can be found at the Gallery of Treasures in the Scarlet Halls.
Scarlet Pupils are level 29-91 elite humans of the Scarlet Crusade that can be found in the Athenaeum in the Scarlet Halls.

Scared Pandaren Cubs are friends of An Windfur and Shin who escaped through the Forest Heart of Jade Forest from the Jade Witch's summoned jade monsters, hiding in the trees until an adventurer got them down.
Scarlet Preservers are humans of the Scarlet Crusade that can be found at the Whispering Gardens in Tirisfal Glades.
Scarlet Augurs are humans of the Scarlet Crusade that can be found outside the instanced part of the Scarlet Monastery.
Scarlet Disciples are humans of the Scarlet Crusade that can be found outside the instanced part of the Scarlet Monastery.
__NOTOC__ Scallions are a cooking ingredient. They can be found on any saurok on Pandaria as well as grown at Sunsong Ranch from Scallion Seeds.
Scallion Seeds are purchased from for in the Halfhill Market. It can be planted at Sunsong Ranch to grow Scallions. Seeds can also rarely be found while harvesting at the farm.
Scarlet Halls Guild Run is a guild achievement that is awarded for defeating they boss of the Scarlet Halls instance while in a guild group.
Scarlet Guardsmen are level 35-36 elite humans of the Scarlet Crusade that could be found inside the Armory wing of the Scarlet Monastery.
Scarderis is a black dragonspawn located at the Obsidian Lair in the Twilight Highlands. He guards the cave leading to Obsidia.
Scalemother Hevna is a sea serpent located in Uldum, near Khartut's Tomb. She is the cause of all the sea serpent eggs appearing in Vir'naal Lake.
This key opens Scarlet Onslaught Trunks found at Onslaught Harbor.

Scarlet Halls: Silver is an achievement earned for completing the Scarlet Halls challenge mode with a rating of silver or better.

Scarlet Invoker are humans located at the Charred Outpost in Western Plaguelands.
Scaleshard is one of the artifacts used by protection warriors in World of Warcraft: Legion. It is automatically equipped in the main hand when wielding the Scale of the Earth-Warder.
Scarlet Confessional Book is sold by at the Underbelly in Dalaran for .

The Scarlet Fleet is the navy of the Scarlet Crusade and later of the Scarlet Onslaught. Admiral Barean Westwind was once its Grand Admiral. It is made up of several frigates, including the Sinner's Folly.
Scales is a murloc located at the Winterfin Retreat in the Borean Tundra.
Scarlet Hymnal is a reward from Fallen Steeds: Saddle of the Headless Horseman.
Scaly is a snail located at Neltharion's Lair. It is sitting on one of the white mushrooms you pass while in the barrel in Broken Teeth. You have to throw a fish at him to knock him into the water.
Retail= |-| Classic= __NOTOC__ Scarlet Curates are undead of the Scarlet Crusade located in Tyr's Hand in Eastern Plaguelands. Before the Cataclysm they were humans.
Scallion Kimchi is a food item sold by food vendors on the Broken Isles for .
Scarlet Archer is a human located in Scarlet Monastery when the Ebon Blade attacked it to raise Sally Whitemane during the Burning Legion's third invasion.

Scared Straight is a Dungeons & Raids achievement earned defeating the Shade of Medivh inside Return to Karazhan on Mythic difficulty. Paranoid is a debuff applied from clicking the Terrifying Stories to Tell at Night book in the Guardian's Library.
Scarlet Inquisitors are humans located in the basement of the barracks in Tyr's Hand in the Eastern Plaguelands. They were torturing Suffering Victims.
Scarlet Mages are humans located at Hearthglen in the Western Plaguelands.
Scarlet Paladins are humans located at Hearthglen in the Western Plaguelands.
Scarlet Corpses are deceased humans located throughout central Deathknell of Tirisfal Glades.
Scarlet Raven is a submarine located at the Lunarfall Shipyard in or at the Frostwall Shipyard in Frostfire Ridge.
Scarlet Fleet Guardians are humans located in the Scarlet Enclave.
Scarlet Deserters are humans located in the Scarlet Enclave. Gothik the Harvester is slowly killing them.
Scarlet Gryphons are gryphons located in the Scarlet Enclave.
Scarlet Lumberjacks are humans located in Western Plaguelands.
__NOTOC__ Scarlet Priests are humans located in the Western Plaguelands.
__NOTOC__ Scalesworn Cultists are humans located in Deepholm.
